values.letter: I do not think I ever said it properly, so here it is written down where you can keep it.

I have started this four times.

What I keep coming back to is that you were right, and that I should have said so at the time instead of a week later. I am sorry.

You did it.

Nobody here is surprised, which is its own kind of compliment. Go and enjoy it properly before you start worrying about what comes next.

Tomorrow will be over before you know it.

Eat something first. Take the blue pen, it is the one that works.
No occasion. I just thought of you this morning and decided that was reason enough.

values.letter:
There is a version of this letter that is one line long, and it just says thank you. I tried that one first and it looked so small on the page that I started again.

What I actually want to say is that the year I spent not knowing what I was doing would have been much worse without you in it. You never once made me feel like the questions were stupid, and you answered the same one three times in March without ever mentioning that you had already answered it.

I have noticed that you do this for everyone. I do not think you know how unusual it is. People assume that kind of patience is a personality trait rather than a decision somebody makes every single day, and I wanted to name it before another year goes past and I forget to.

So: thank you. For the time, for the patience, for the three answers in March. I hope someone does the same for you, and I hope you let them.
Found this while clearing out the cupboard. You were three, and absolutely furious about the hat.
